hook: They agreed on everything. Except the house.
cta_sub: Cash, as-is, on your timeline. Florida only.

beats.say: We agreed on everything in the divorce. Except the house.
Listing it means months of showings, repairs, and talking to him about every offer.
I just want this chapter to be over.
Karen, I'm Casa. I'm sorry you're going through this. Can I show you a simpler way?
We make one written cash offer. Both of you can see exactly how we got to the number. No showings, no repairs, no back and forth with buyers.
That sounds too easy. What's the catch?
No catch. The offer is no obligation, and everything closes through a local title company, so the money is handled by a neutral third party.
How fast could it be done?
In as few as twenty one days. Or we can line it up with your timeline, if one of you needs more time to move.
So it's just one decision. Not fifty.
Exactly. One offer, one closing date, and you both move on.
If you're going through a divorce and need to sell a Florida house cleanly, DM the word OFFER, and we'll send you a no obligation cash offer.
